Subject: Coordinating a single multi-company office hours / group demo — pick preferred slot

Hi all —

Thanks for the interest in seeing Redwood Inference in action. To make the best use of everyone’s time we’re organizing a single group office-hours/demo session that will cover: platform overview, live demo (model serving + routing), and a short Q&A on security/regions.

Please pick the slot that works best for your team from the options below (I’ve tried to span time zones):

- Option A: Thu, June 24 — 10:00–11:00 PDT / 13:00–14:00 EDT
- Option B: Fri, June 25 — 15:00–16:00 BST / 10:00–11:00 EDT
- Option C: Mon, June 28 — 08:00–09:00 PDT / 16:00–17:00 IST

Quick asks: reply with your preferred option + how many attendees you expect (helps us size demo environment).

I attached a short session deck and a draft agenda — will finalize after we lock a slot. If none of these work, reply with two alternatives and we’ll try to consolidate.

Best,
Priyom
